mapper.select: WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND participant_id = #{participantId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{applicationId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO applications ( id, space_id, event_id, form_id, participant_id, status, submitted_at, revision, previous_application_id, revised_by, revised_by_user_id, changes) VALUES ( #{id}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{formId}, #{participantId}, 'SUBMITTED', #{submittedAt}, #{revision}, #{previousId}, #{revisedBy}, #{revisedByUserId}, CAST(#{changes} AS jsonb))
